titolo: King’s Trust and OpenAI announce £1 million partnership to train 25,000 UK youths in AI
descr: The King’s Trust and OpenAI have launched a partnership funded with £1 million.
paragrafi: The King’s Trust and OpenAI have launched a partnership funded with £1 million.
The programme targets up to 25,000 young people in the UK, offering practical AI training for work.
Funding will be used to develop courses and resources that teach AI concepts and applications.
The collaboration follows growing demand for AI skills in the UK labour market.
OpenAI and the charity plan to roll out the training over the coming months.
perche: For AI users, the partnership expands access to skill development, helping more people qualify for AI‑related jobs. For those seeking free or locally hosted models, a larger skilled community may boost contributions to open‑source AI projects.
